Name: Canonicalization
Required Evidence: Authoritative taxonomy, repository map, specification index, canonical URLs
Exit Criteria: No duplicate or contradictory public artifacts remain

Name: Reproducible Software
Required Evidence: Frontend/backend repos, locked dependencies, CI, migrations, API spec, local dev guide
Exit Criteria: Clean-room build and test pass from published instructions

Name: Deployment Provenance
Required Evidence: Commit embedded in deployment, staging/production separation, health/version endpoints, logs, rollback
Exit Criteria: Each deployed surface maps to release and commit SHA

Name: Security Assurance
Required Evidence: Threat model, DPIA, auth model, secrets evidence, abuse tests, rate limiting, retention, SAST/DAST
Exit Criteria: Security review package complete; critical issues closed or risk-accepted

Name: Research Validation
Required Evidence: Construct definitions, literature verification, questions, protocol, expert instrument, pilot design, analysis plan
Exit Criteria: Reviewable research protocol ready for CEITR/IRB/expert panel

Name: Conformance Program
Required Evidence: Normative registry, machine-readable vectors, verifier, negative tests, interoperability profile
Exit Criteria: Independent test run can evaluate implementation claims

Name: Commercial Productization
Required Evidence: Initial customer, bounded use case, SOW, pricing, terms, support, liability, implementation guide

Name: External Validation
Required Evidence: Independent technical review, institutional pilot, academic review, standards feedback, design partner, security review
Exit Criteria: At least two external validation signals obtained
